headline: Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez, DT Christian Barmore Out For Week 4
summary: If the Patriots are to win tomorrow’s divisional clash with the Bills, they will do so with a shorthanded defense. Cornerback Christian Gonzalez and defensive tackle Christian Barmore will be sidelined for Week 4. Both players are dealing with shoulder injuries. headline: Eagles WR Devonta Smith To Miss Multiple Games
summary: Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith is expected to be sidelined for multiple games with a “lingering right hamstring injury that initially caused him to miss time during camp,” per Olivia Reiner of The Philadelphia Inquirer. Smith, 27, should not be out for more than three games with no injured reserve placement expected at the time. […]

headline: Packers OLB Micah Parsons Might Not Play Until November
summary: Currently on the reserve/PUP list, Packers outside linebacker Micah Parsons will be eligible to play in Week 5. headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels Working To Return In Week 5; WR Terry McLaurin Could Miss Week 4
summary: With Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels still recovering from the dislocated left elbow he suffered in Week 2, backup Marcus Mariota will make his second straight start on Sunday. headline: Panthers place WR Xavier Legette on IR with knee injury
summary: The Carolina Panthers have placed 2024 first-round pick Xavier Legette on injured reserve ahead of Sunday's prime-time matchup against the Detroit Lions.
